pages.title: Chapter Overview
pages.text: Register at Tianyuan, earn passage through service, and follow the higher-realm paths beyond Fengyuan.$(br2)This chapter contains 14 authored quest lines. The index describes routes and does not replace server progress.

pages.title: Tianyuan Arrival Registration
pages.text: Old mortal-realm status means little here; register first and adapt to Spirit Realm qi.

pages.title: Passage into Fengyuan
pages.text: The controlled gate opens for merit, and not one point less.

pages.title: True Word Outer-Sect Lesson
pages.text: Words carry law here; outer disciples may listen before they are allowed to ask.

pages.title: Great Five Elements Illusory World
pages.text: The Illusory World seed is not a toy, and contemplation requires earned standing.

pages.title: Reincarnation Hall Introduction
pages.text: Read the backlash terms before signing a contract for forbidden goods.

pages.title: Heavenly Court Gray-Realm Hunt
pages.text: Choose whether to kill or capture the Gray Realm agents named on the warrant.

pages.title: Black Wind Sea Passage
pages.text: Follow the flag, wind, and helmsman; favored agents of the Court are refused passage.

pages.title: Guanghan Endgame Path
pages.text: The Spirit Refinement Art is unique, and a True Immortal's pressure is not a farmable boss encounter.

pages.title: Ascension into the Immortal Realm
pages.text: Tribulation is only the admission token; arrival begins an entirely new path.

pages.title: True Word Sect Cultivation Path
pages.text: The True Word Sect is a ladder of qualifications from lectures to the Illusory World.

pages.title: Law of Time Path
pages.text: The law of time is not idle acceleration, and reversal carries heavenly consequences.

pages.title: Reincarnation Hall Path
pages.text: A long route from introductions to deeper contracts, forbidden goods, and debts.

pages.title: Black Wind Sea and the Gray Realm
pages.text: Black Wind is the road and the Gray Realm is the fog, with no sign pointing back.

pages.title: A Glimpse of the Immortal Endgame
pages.text: The endgame offers distant hooks, not a guaranteed path to final victory.
